articles.title: As housing protests sweep Portugal, police and politicians here seem bent on making the crisis worse | Ana Naomi de Sousa
articles.summary:
While Spain, Germany and the UK have all introduced laws protecting renters’ rights, Luís Montenegro’s centre-right government is empowering landlords

As Storm Charles reached Portugal’s shores this week, flights were aborted, schools were closed, and the global Web Summit in Lisbon was forced to cancel a whole day of lucrative events. But even the promise of some very bad weather was not enough to deter housing protesters from setting up camp for another night on the streets.

Since 14 October, echoing recent eruptions over housing in Spain, and the fierce student-led protests in France, Lisbon and Porto have become the focus for encampments and daily protests drawing people in their thousands. Almost one month later, they show no sign of disappearing.

Germany has had 12 presidents since the end of the second world war, all of them men. Now, for the first time, the federal republic is on the brink of getting a female head of state. But Ilse Aigner, the lead candidate for the post, is unusual in more ways than one.

articles.title: Ukraine war briefing: Europe to join negotiations, says Kushner, as Putin warns against peace keepers
articles.summary:
Jared Kushner says move will allow talks to address ‘broader postwar European security arrangements’; Putin refuses to soften territorial demands. What we know on day 1,724

Ukraine and Russia have agreed to expand the next round of peace negotiations to include European countries, Donald Trump’s envoy and son-in-law Jared Kushner said late on Thursday, after meeting Russian president Vladimir Putin. “This will allow us to address the broader postwar European security arrangements alongside the territorial issues between Ukraine and Russia,” Kushner ​said ​later on X. “We are also working toward ‌what would be the largest prisoner ​exchange of the war, potentially reuniting thousands of people ⁠with their families.”

After the Moscow meeting, Kushner and Witkoff flew ⁠to Ireland to attend a European summit and meet Zelenskyy, who said he was pleased at the prospect of European participation in talks and said he hoped the agenda would include steps towards a ceasefire and de-escalating the conflict. “We decided that we will work on an agenda about any kind of de-escalation, some kind of ceasefires,” Zelenskyy said after meeting the US envoys. “I hope that we will have such agenda,” he said.

Putin warned Europe not to send peacekeeping troops into Ukraine in the event of a peace deal saying it was a “continuation of war”. Putin also refused to soften his territorial demands and said Washington must work with its European allies to understand if they want peace or war in Ukraine.

Putin’s comments underlined how ⁠difficult the negotiations could become, given sharp differences between Moscow ​and European capitals over the way the war should end. “The Europeans will join at the next meeting, which we consider to be a very important moment because they are our partners and it’s important to us that they take part,” Witkoff told Russian state TV after meeting Putin in the Kremlin.

Kushner told Putin Washington had detected what he called “a big change” on the European side and was confident that expanding peace talks to include the Europeans would not hinder progress. Putin said Moscow had always been open to talking to the EU about Ukraine, but ​signalled serious outstanding differences. “As far as the Europeans are concerned, we have never been opposed to engaging in dialogue ‌with Europe, and we have never broken off that dialogue. It was ‌they who broke off the dialogue with the Russian Federation,” he said. “We would very much like you, gentlemen, and the US administration as a whole, to work with your European allies so that they can finally make up their minds as to what they want: peace or war in Ukraine,” said Putin.

However, Zelenskyy said new restrictions were affecting the US-made satellite communications Kyiv uses on the battlefield, and that he found the US approach of discussing a new European security order with Russia “a bit strange”. Earlier on Thursday, he said disruptions to the Starshield satellite ​communications service had affected the entire frontline and Russian-controlled parts of Ukraine. Starshield is the military version of SpaceX’s Starlink satellite communications service, and Ukraine suffered similar disruptions last month. “So far we know very little (on the Starshield restrictions). But some things are already clear: if someone in America is making decisions that basically treat Ukrainian territory as if it is not Ukrainian, then it tells us where things are going,” he said. SpaceX declined to comment.

During the talks, the conflict between the two countries continued. A Russian drone ⁠strike killed two people in the ⁠northern ⁠Ukrainian ​region of Sumy, Governor Oleh Hryhorov said ⁠on Telegram late on Thursday, while in Rivne ⁠in the north-west, ​five ‌people were injured ‌after a Russian drone hit ‌an apartment building, a local Ukrainian official said on Telegram early on Friday. In Russia’s ‌Belgorod region bordering Ukraine, a man ​was killed and another four injured in a drone attack, ⁠local officials said on Telegram ​on ​Thursday. Meanwhile, Ukrainian agricultural company Kernel Holding said on ⁠Thursday it had suspended operations at all its oilseed extraction plants ⁠following a ⁠series ​of Russian attacks on its facilities.

archive.security_status_en: Europe faces escalating geopolitical pressures amid ongoing Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi and concerns over a potential US policy shift under pressure. The economic environment is strained by rising wage inflation, energy volatility, and intensifying protectionist measures against Chinese imports.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává, že trhy budou reagovat především na výstupy z trilateralních mírových rozhovorů v Abú Dhabí a na napětí kolem námořních hranic ve Středozemním moři.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to react primarily to the outcomes of trilateral peace talks in Abu Dhabi and tensions over Mediterranean maritime borders.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí komplexní vlně bezpečnostních a sociálních výzev, včetně koordovaných bombových hrozeb napříč státy, rostoucího napětí ve Španělsku kvůli bytové krizi a pokračujících trilateralních jednání o Ukrajině v Abú Dhabí. Současně Evropská centrální banka monitoruje mírně rostoucí mzdové tlaky a geopolitické napětí se projevuje i v kybernetické bezpečnosti či energetice.
archive.security_status_en: Europe faces a complex wave of security and social challenges, including coordinated cross-border bomb threats, rising domestic tensions in Spain over the housing crisis, and ongoing trilateral Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi. Simultaneously, the ECB is monitoring slightly rising wage pressures, while geopolitical tensions spill over into cybersecurity and energy sectors.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává vyhodnocení výsledků ukrajinských mírových rozhovorů v Abú Dhabí a reakce trhů na politické a sociální nepokoje v jižní Evropě.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to digest the outcomes of the Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi and react to political and social unrest in Southern Europe.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně sociálních nepokojů, v čele se Španělskem, kde masové generální stávky a protesty za dostupnost bydlení vyústily v násilné střety s policií. Mezitím probíhají klíčová jednání o budoucím bezpečnostním uspořádání Ukrajiny a unijní instituce řeší legislativní pat v oblasti pracovních práv a klimatické politiky.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of social unrest, led by Spain where mass general strikes and housing protests have erupted into violent clashes with police. Meanwhile, critical talks on Ukraine's post-war security framework continue alongside legislative stalemates in EU institutions regarding labor rights and climate policy.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává vyhodnocení výsledků ukrajinských mírových rozhovorů v Abú Dhabí a reakce trhů na politické a sociální nepokojů v jižní Evropě.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to digest the outcomes of the Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi and react to political and social unrest in Southern Europe.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí kombinaci vážných bezpečnostních a sociálních výzev, včetně pokračujících ruských útoků na ukrajinskou energetickou infrastrukturu a výpadků systému Starlink. Masivní generální stávka v gpointer-Španělsku kvůli cenám bydlení a eskalace politického napětí na jihu kontinentu zvyšují vnitřní nestabilitu. Tyto faktory spolu s geopolitickým tlakem na obranu vytvářejí složité prostředí pro finanční trhy a instituce EU.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a combination of severe security and social challenges, including ongoing Russian strikes on Ukraine's energy grid and disruptions to the Starlink system. A massive general strike in Spain over housing costs and escalating political tensions in southern Europe are heightening internal instability. These factors, alongside geopolitical pressures on defense, create a complex operating environment for financial markets and EU institutions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává reakce trhů na vývoj diplomatických jednání ohledně Ukrajiny a stabilizaci situace po sociálních nepokojích ve Španělsku.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, markets are expected to react to diplomatic developments regarding Ukraine and the stabilization of the situation following social unrest in Spain.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí vlně sociálních nepokojů a generálních stávok (zejména ve Španělsku a Portugalsku) kvůli bytové krizi a životním nákladům. Současně se otevírají klíčová diplomatická jednání o Ukrajině za účasti amerických zmocněnců a evropských lídrů, zatímco energetická infrastruktura na Ukrajině nadále čelí ruským útokům.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing a wave of social unrest and general strikes (particularly in Spain and Portugal) driven by the housing crisis and cost of living. Simultaneously, crucial diplomatic negotiations on Ukraine are opening with the participation of US envoys and European leaders, while Ukrainian energy infrastructure continues to face Russian strikes.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech se očekává zvýšená volatilita na trzích v reakci na vývoj mírových jednání ohledně Ukrajiny a dopady sociálních protestů na jižní křídlo EU.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, increased market volatility is expected in response to developments in Ukraine peace talks and the impacts of social protests on the EU's southern flank.
